## Unmarked fragments, resolved by context

```{lmd}
return pandoc.Div({
  {= A paragraph that stays a paragraph. =},
  pandoc.Para({ pandoc.Strong({= bold via inline context =}) }),
  {= a ``{lmd} {= nested `{lmd} name` =}`` c =},
  pandoc.Nodes({ pandoc.Str("hand-built inlines become a Plain") }),
}, pandoc.Attr("", {"box"}))
```

Inline: `{lmd} {= *hi*, =}` `{lmd} name`.

## A fragment reused as a component

````{lmd}
local function card(title)
  return {=:
### `{lmd} title`

Body.
:=}
end
local out = pandoc.Blocks({})
for _, t in ipairs({ "Hello", "Bye", "Hello" }) do out:extend(card(t)) end
return out
````
